prompt: What does the readiness brief identify as the binding constraint?

atoms.text: Substation 14 is the binding constraint. Its transformer bank was derated in September after the oil analysis came back.

blocks.display: Substation 14 is the binding constraint. Its transformer bank was derated in September after the oil analysis came back.

sources.title: Winter readiness brief
sources.excerpt: Substation 14 is the binding constraint. Its transformer bank was derated in September after the oil analysis came back, and the two feeders that would otherwise pick up its load both run through the same corridor, so a fault on either leaves the northern ring supplied from one direction only.
uses: Identifies the binding winter constraint and why the bank was derated.

findings.text: The readiness brief identifies Substation 14 as the binding constraint and records the transformer-bank derating.

prompt: Why do the two feeder alternatives not remove that exposure?

atoms.text: Both feeders run through the same corridor, so a fault on either leaves the northern ring supplied from one direction only.

blocks.display: Both feeders run through the same corridor, so a fault on either leaves the northern ring supplied from one direction only.

sources.title: Winter readiness brief
sources.excerpt: the two feeders that would otherwise pick up its load both run through the same corridor, so a fault on either leaves the northern ring supplied from one direction only.
uses: Explains the shared-corridor failure mode of the alternate feeders.

findings.text: The two alternate feeders share one corridor, so either corridor fault leaves the northern ring supplied from one direction.

prompt: What does the replacement decision actually recommend?

atoms.text: It recommends authorizing the accelerated replacement window and reserving the mobile bank until commissioning tests close.

blocks.display: It recommends authorizing the accelerated replacement window and reserving the mobile bank until commissioning tests close.

sources.title: Transformer bank replacement decision
sources.excerpt: Authorize the accelerated replacement window and reserve the mobile bank until commissioning tests close. The premium preserves winter contingency and avoids a second planned outage.
uses: States the recommended replacement timing and mobile-bank reservation.

findings.text: The decision recommends accelerating the replacement window and reserving the mobile bank through commissioning.
